subject: Future Tech
title: Surface Area Revolution
description: A 60-second lesson on Surface Area Revolution.

hook.text: Cut a sugar cube into nanoscale pieces and its surface area equals a football field.

buildup.text: Chemical reactions happen on surfaces. More surface area means faster reactions.

discovery.text: Nano-sized catalysts speed up reactions using a fraction of the material.

twist.text: The same reactivity that makes nanoparticles useful also makes them potentially dangerous.

climax.text: Understanding surface-to-volume ratios is the key to nanotech.

punchline.text: Smaller particles, bigger surfaces, wilder chemistry.

quiz.question: Why are nanoparticles more chemically reactive?
options: They have vastly more surface area relative to volume
